tagline: Leading European airline group connecting people and places
hero_kpi_rationale: Operating Profit is IAG's primary KPI, reflecting the profitability of its core airline operations following post-pandemic restructuring and amid high volatility in fuel and labor costs. A sharp rebound to €1,197.7M in 2024 from €129.5M in 2023 demonstrates the strength of air traffic recovery, with year-on-year growth of 826%.

kpis.name: Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from core operations before taxes.
kpis.description: Operating profit increased from €129.5M in 2023 to €1,197.681M in 2024, driven by strong recovery in air traffic and disciplined cost management.
kpis.signal: Sharp rebound in operating profit in 2024 following a challenging 2023.

kpis.name: Net Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses, taxes, and financial charges.
kpis.description: Net profit reached €941.797M in 2024 compared to a loss of €22.749M in 2023, marking a significant improvement in the group's financial health.
kpis.signal: Return to net profitability in 2024 after a loss in 2023.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the group's core services.
kpis.description: Revenue surged from €6,448.993M in 2023 to €31,464.314M in 2024, reflecting strong demand for air travel and increased operational capacity.
kpis.signal: Very strong revenue growth in 2024, driven by air traffic recovery.

kpis.name: Cash and Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Liquidity available to meet operational needs.
kpis.description: Cash and equivalents rose from €1,354.219M in 2023 to €2,382.220M in 2024, supported by cash flow generation and debt financing.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in cash, strengthening financial resilience.

kpis.name: Net Debt
kpis.explanation: Total financial debt minus available cash.
kpis.description: Net debt stood at €7,961.432M in 2024 versus €8,117.521M in 2023 (based on total debt of €10,343.652M in 2024 minus cash of €2,382.220M), reflecting refinancing of short- and long-term debt.
kpis.signal: Relatively stable net debt despite increased activity.

kpis.name: Employee Costs
kpis.explanation: Expenses related to salaries, social charges, and other personnel costs.
kpis.description: Employee costs increased from €1,965.920M in 2023 to €2,586.967M in 2024, reflecting workforce redeployment with traffic growth and improved compensation.
kpis.signal: Rising employee costs linked to business recovery and workforce expansion.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €42.85B in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of €14.27B in the latest year

risks.title: Dependence on strategic airline partners
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the group's strategic context, with strong language affirming the importance of partnerships. The trend is stable, and the category is central to the business model.

risks.title: Intense competition on international routes
risks.score_rationale: The document highlights competitive pressure in global markets, with strong language on the need to maintain leadership positions. A recurring and strategic risk.

risks.title: Exposure to decisions by Qatar Airways
risks.score_rationale: Qatar Airways is identified as a significant shareholder. The risk is moderate in intensity but strategic, with recurring presence in disclosures.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of booking systems
risks.score_rationale: The risk is implicit in digital investments and customer data management. Although not explicitly stated, it is inferred from the group's IT and digital priorities.

risks.title: Dependence on synergies between group airlines
risks.score_rationale: The business model relies on capturing synergies between British Airways, Iberia, Vueling, etc. The language emphasizes this strategic priority, with a stable trend.

risks.title: Increased regulation of airline mergers
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions costs related to the failed acquisition of Air Europa, indicating a strict regulatory environment. Strong language and an upward trend.

risks.title: Management of key group talent
risks.score_rationale: The document emphasizes leadership and group culture. Loss of senior executives or strategic talent could impact transformation.

risks.title: Reputational risk from regulatory disputes
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing disputes are mentioned (€3.5M in contingent liabilities), with potential impact on brand image. Trend is stable, but risk is recurring.

ai_positioning.summary: IAG does not mention any strategic initiatives related to artificial intelligence in its recent financial reports. The company does not position AI as a lever for transformation or competitiveness.
evidence: No mention of AI in the 2024 annual report
Absence of AI-related KPIs or projects in the Business and MD&A sections
No reference to automation or predictive analytics tools
